rule.name: SpringLocalCacheWriteInTransaction
rule.message: Write this in-memory cache or memo map after the commit (in a TransactionSynchronization afterCommit callback, a @TransactionalEventListener, or the caller once the transactional call returns). Written inside the transaction, it keeps a value or a generated id that a rollback undoes, and other threads read it until it expires.
